from pydantic import BaseModel, Field

class FinancialMetricRecord(BaseModel):
    """One specific line-item amount extracted from a single financial report."""
    company: str | None = Field(description="Name of the company the report belongs to")
    period: str | None = Field(description="The reporting period covered by this document (e.g. '2022 年一季度')")
    metric_name: str | None = Field(description="The specific line item name in the report (e.g. '收到其他与经营活动有关的现金')")
    amount: float | None = Field(description="The reported monetary amount for the current period")
    currency: str | None = Field(description="Currency unit (e.g. '元')")

class Parse(BaseModel):
    financial_metrics: list[FinancialMetricRecord]
